notes.title: DEMO Update Announcement
notes.notes: [p]To Followers[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for your continued support![/p][p][/p][p]To enhance gameplay and streamline storylines, the game demo has undergone a new round of updates this year.[/p][p][/p][p]This update introduces several auxiliary plugins, which will inevitably cause corruption of older save files (created before September 2025).[/p][p][/p][p]Due to limited technical resources, this issue cannot be resolved at present, potentially requiring you to restart your playthrough.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]Update List:[/p][p][/p][p]· Combat system modifications[/p][p]· Partial storyline alterations[/p][p]· Changes to certain book content[/p][p]· Menu interface optimization[/p][p]· Backpack item indicator icon improvements[/p][p] From 诚夏[/p]
